It solves the problem of inconsistent scene scales and coordinate frames in neural rendering datasets, ensuring that training inputs are normalized to a canonical range (typically $[-1, 1]^3$) to improve optimization stability and generalization.

Unlike [PCA Pose Alignment](7626-pca-pose-alignment.md), which aligns principal components of the data distribution, this method relies on explicit geometric alignment of the camera viewing directions and mean center, often derived solely from context views.
